_: The apps the SideStore source lists (ci/sidestore_source.py): each from this repository's releases tagged <tag>-<n> that carry an .ipa asset. Terra's ipa job and adrift.yml both regenerate the source from here.

apps.name: Terra Incognita
apps.subtitle: The world, closer and closer
apps.localizedDescription: A wandering atlas in the making: a live globe, and a workbench of prototypes to try on it, from illustrated natural histories to geographic studies and the first films. Offline, apart from the workbench's optional prototype packs.

apps.name: Adrift
apps.subtitle: Glass floats on the real sea
apps.localizedDescription: Tap the open sea and it rings; rest a beat longer and a glass float is yours, lamp amber on a cool sea. The month's real currents and winds, measured by drifting buoys, carry it; nothing scripts where it goes. Written from scratch in Rust on the GPU. Offline; every dataset credited.
